keywords.def: a deadly disease spread by dirty water
an underground pipe that carries waste away
too many people in a small space

questions.q: Why did deaths cluster round the Broad Street pump?
Name one difference between rich and poor homes.
Core: Use the simplified Snow map: count deaths near each of three pumps, then explain in the portal response box what the evidence shows.
questions.a: Correct counts with most near Broad Street; explanation linking water to cholera

questions.q: Extend: Why were the poor hit hardest by cholera?
questions.a: Shared dirty water, overcrowding, no sewers

questions.q: Stretch: Why did many people still believe in 'bad air'?
questions.a: Germs could not be seen, and dirty places smelled bad
B) Dirty water. Snow showed it came from sewage in drinking water, not bad air.

questions.q: Big question: how could one pump make a street ill?
questions.a: Its water was polluted with sewage carrying cholera
